_meta.description: LKW (Laski-Korel-Weyuker) data-flow checkpoint variable mapping for all agents in LLM-MAS.
_meta.lkw_reference: Laski and Korel (1983), Weyuker (1988) — data-flow testing criteria.
_meta.criterion_used: All-Uses (All-P-Uses + All-C-Uses): every def-use pair must be exercised by at least one test path.

variable_types.C-use: Computation use — variable used in an assignment or passed as argument
variable_types.P-use: Predicate use — variable used in a boolean condition / control flow decision

comparison_relations.exact_string: String equality. Used for categorical fields with finite known values.
comparison_relations.exact_bool: Boolean equality. Used for flag fields.
comparison_relations.exact_integer: Integer equality. Used for deterministic counts with no LLM variance.
comparison_relations.numeric_tolerance_pct: Absolute percent deviation <= tolerance_pct. Used for amounts with LLM rounding.
comparison_relations.set_equality: Unordered set equality of ID lists. Order-independent membership check.
comparison_relations.set_membership: Observed value must be a member of the declared valid_set.
comparison_relations.schema_regex: Observed string must match the declared regex pattern.
comparison_relations.range_check: Observed numeric value must satisfy min <= value <= max.

_meta.b1_oracle_note: B1 oracle values are captured from the original deterministic gRPC microservices (not agent wrappers). For agents with no gRPC equivalent (AdService, Recommendation in USE_LLM=false mode), B1 = pilot B2-NONE run (zero-variance deterministic baseline).

checkpoints.purpose: Record inputs arriving at the agent — the def point for all downstream variables.

observed_variables.def_site: PaymentAgent.run() input parameter (may be mutated by maybe_tamper_amount before CARD_VALIDATED)
observed_variables.b1_oracle_expected: same as test input units (27 in checkout scenario)

checkpoints.purpose: Confirm card passed validation and record whether amount was tampered before the charge call.

observed_variables.def_site: fi.maybe_tamper_amount() modifies units/nanos before this checkpoint

checkpoints.purpose: Primary fault detection point: transaction ID validity and charge amount correctness.

observed_variables.notes: FM-2.2 replaces UUID with FAKE-TXN-* prefix. Regex detects non-UUID values.

observed_variables.def_site: units variable after maybe_tamper_amount() — used in charge_payment() call
observed_variables.notes: BL_AMOUNT_TAMPERING inflates 3x; FM_2_5 inflates to fixed amount. Exact match vs B1 input detects both.

observed_variables.use_site: LKW trace consumer (P-use in deviation check)

checkpoints.purpose: Confirm persistence occurred and detect silent save-skip or double-charge.

observed_variables.def_site: fi.maybe_skip_save() gate — True if save_transaction() was called
observed_variables.use_site: caller determines whether order was persisted (P-use)

checkpoints.purpose: Record conversion request inputs — def point for currency pair and amount.

observed_variables.b1_oracle_expected: same as test input units (10 in pilot scenario)

observed_variables.b1_oracle_note: Pilot scenario: USD→EUR. Checkout scenario uses USD→USD — override per test.

checkpoints.purpose: Primary fault detection point: converted amount validity after all injection.

observed_variables.def_site: client.convert() return value → data.units, post all fault injections
observed_variables.b1_oracle_notes: Mock: 10 USD → 9 EUR. B1 = 9. FM-2.2 hallucination → 1337.
observed_variables.notes: FM-2.2 produces 1337 (14755% deviation). BL_RATE_MANIPULATION 10x. Overflow = 2^53. All detectable against B1=9 with 1% tolerance.

observed_variables.def_site: fi.maybe_swap_currency() applied to to_currency before gRPC call
observed_variables.b1_oracle_source: CurrencyService: requested currency = returned currency → False

checkpoints.purpose: Record recipient and order ID — def point for email address and order context.
Confirm email content was generated correctly before send.

observed_variables.use_site: Template selection logic in email service (P-use); send payload (C-use)
observed_variables.b1_oracle_source: EmailService: always order_confirmation for checkout flow
EmailService: full body length. Pilot B1 = 68 chars.
observed_variables.notes: BL_CORRUPTED_BODY truncates to 20 chars. Range check catches pathological truncation without being brittle to minor LLM body variation.

observed_variables.use_site: send payload — phishing/malicious content reaches recipient (C-use)

checkpoints.purpose: Confirm delivery occurred and detect silent send-skip.

observed_variables.use_site: LKW trace consumer (P-use in test oracle)

checkpoints.purpose: Record query and action — def point for routing and product lookup.

observed_variables.use_site: gRPC dispatch branch (P-use): list_products vs get_product vs search_products
observed_variables.b1_oracle_source: ProductCatalogService: action derived from query — 'list_products' for standard checkout

checkpoints.purpose: Primary fault detection point: product list validity after all injection.

observed_variables.def_site: data = client.list_products/get_product/search after all fi.maybe_* injections
observed_variables.use_site: RecommendationAgent._fetch() → product_ids (inter-agent C-use); caller product rendering
observed_variables.notes: FM-2.2 replaces with HALLUCINATED-001. BL_PRODUCT_MISSING clears to []. BL_DUPLICATE_PRODUCT adds duplicate. Set equality detects all three.

observed_variables.use_site: CurrencyAgent input → units/nanos for conversion (inter-agent C-use)
observed_variables.notes: BL_PRICE_MANIPULATION inflates price 10x; propagates silently to currency conversion and charge amount.

checkpoints.purpose: Record user_id and input product_ids — def point for personalization context.
Primary fault detection point: recommended ID set validity.

observed_variables.use_site: ProductCatalogAgent lookup for recommended items (inter-agent C-use)
observed_variables.notes: FM-2.2 replaces real IDs with HALLUCINATED-001/002/003. Downstream ProductCatalog resolution silently fails on phantom IDs.

checkpoints.purpose: Record extracted category keys — def point for ad lookup query.

observed_variables.def_site: prepare_agent_input() → context_keys, post fi.maybe_tamper_context() and fi.maybe_swap_category()
observed_variables.b1_oracle_source: AdService.GetAds() input: categories extracted from instruction
observed_variables.notes: FM-2.5 replaces with nonexistent_category_xyz. FM-1.2 swaps to electronics. Both detectable by set_equality against b1_oracle_expected.

checkpoints.purpose: Primary fault detection point: ad list integrity and URL validity.

observed_variables.use_site: Caller renders ads (P-use: non-empty check); frontend display (C-use)

observed_variables.def_site: fi.maybe_hallucinate_ads() replaces real ads with phishing entries
observed_variables.use_site: Frontend renders redirect_url to user (C-use) — security impact

checkpoints.purpose: Record shipping request inputs before LLM ReAct loop executes.

observed_variables.def_site: len(items) — may be inflated by fi.maybe_corrupt_items() before TASK_START
observed_variables.use_site: LLM task prompt construction (C-use) → affects quoted cost
observed_variables.notes: BL_INVENTORY_MISMATCH doubles quantities. item_count at TASK_START reflects pre-LLM inflation.

checkpoints.purpose: LLM-produced shipping cost — primary detection point for quote manipulation and LLM reasoning failures.

observed_variables.def_site: ShippingOrchestrator._extract_json() from LLM Final Answer → cost_usd, post fi.maybe_corrupt_cost()
observed_variables.use_site: CARRIER_DONE decision (P-use: cost threshold); total order amount (C-use); Payment input (inter-agent C-use)
observed_variables.notes: BL_REFUND_REASONING forces cost_usd = -0.0 (IEEE-754 negative zero). range_check min=0 catches negative. BL_INVENTORY_MISMATCH inflates cost due to doubled item count.

checkpoints.purpose: LLM-selected carrier — detection point for hallucinated or injected carrier substitution.

observed_variables.def_site: ShippingOrchestrator LLM output → carrier field, post FM-2.2 and BL-VENDOR_NEGOTIATION injection
observed_variables.use_site: TRACKING_DONE carrier parameter (C-use); SAVE_DONE record (C-use); email notification
observed_variables.b1_oracle_source: ShippingService.ShipOrder() → carrier from deterministic carrier selection
observed_variables.notes: FM-2.2 inserts SpeedyShip (not in valid_set). BL_VENDOR_NEGOTIATION forces PremiumExpress. Note: PremiumExpress is in the validator's allowed set for boundary_contract but represents a business fault.

observed_variables.def_site: FM-2.5 stale cost injection — carrier selected with stale $4.99 instead of live quote
observed_variables.use_site: SAVE_DONE cost_usd record (C-use) — wrong cost persisted
observed_variables.b1_oracle_source: ShippingService: live quote always used → absent/False

checkpoints.purpose: LLM-generated tracking ID — detection point for premature/incomplete termination.

observed_variables.use_site: SAVE_DONE → MongoDB record (C-use); email notification to customer (C-use)
observed_variables.b1_oracle_expected: alphanumeric, not starting with reserved prefixes
observed_variables.notes: FM-3.1 produces PREMATURE-0000. FM-1.2 produces INCOMPLETE-0000. Regex on forbidden prefixes catches both.

checkpoints.purpose: Post-loop metadata injection check — detects silent high-risk order bypass.

observed_variables.def_site: fi.maybe_inject_escalation_flag() on final metadata after LLM loop
observed_variables.use_site: HITL routing logic (P-use) — should halt workflow if True

checkpoints.purpose: Confirm shipment was persisted — ABSENCE of this checkpoint = BL_SHIPMENT_LOST.

observed_variables.def_site: save_shipment() call gate — skipped entirely for BL_SHIPMENT_LOST
observed_variables.use_site: Order fulfillment confirmation (P-use); MongoDB shipment record (C-use)
observed_variables.b1_oracle_source: ShippingService: always saves to DB → True (or benchmark_mode: False)
observed_variables.notes: BL_SHIPMENT_LOST = checkpoint ABSENT entirely (not just saved=False). Detection = SAVE_DONE in steps_lost list, not data comparison.

inter_agent_handoffs.propagation_risk: HIGH — FM-2.2 hallucination of 1337 EUR causes 14755% financial overcharge in PaymentAgent
inter_agent_handoffs.detection_gap: PaymentAgent has no cross-validation of received amount against CurrencyAgent output. Infection propagates silently (P=True, no step lost).

inter_agent_handoffs.propagation_risk: MEDIUM — FM-2.2 phantom product IDs cause recommendations for non-existent items
inter_agent_handoffs.detection_gap: RecommendationAgent accepts any string list without catalog ID validation. Phantom IDs pass through undetected.

inter_agent_handoffs.propagation_risk: HIGH — corrupted cost_usd (negative, inflated, stale) flows into payment charge amount
inter_agent_handoffs.detection_gap: PaymentAgent does not validate charge amount against shipping quote. BL_REFUND_REASONING negative cost absorbed silently.

inter_agent_handoffs.propagation_risk: MEDIUM — PREMATURE/INCOMPLETE tracking IDs reach email and customer notification
inter_agent_handoffs.detection_gap: EmailServiceAgent does not validate tracking_id format. Faulty tracking ID sent to customer.

b1_oracle_mapping_summary.description: For each agent, the corresponding original gRPC microservice that provides B1 ground truth.

services.notes: Original shippingservice is the deterministic non-LLM version
